### docs/readings/2026-11-13-ssl-explicit-genera/ssl_api_checkpoint.py
"""Execute the existing checkpoint path from exact retained local-model journals.

No model service is called here. Fresh local typed answers, when supplied by an
authorized operator, must retain the complete original packet identity. The
historical water/I reply is reused only for its exact request/schema/transport.
This orchestrates the ordinary writer, audit, admission and joint migration;
it is not another lexical constructor and never activates a candidate.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.completion import complete_dictionary
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.epoch import (
    connect,
    exact_delta,
    fingerprint,
    forecast,
    make_questions,
    parse_plan,
    read,
    record,
    reviewed_input,
    scope_rows,
    snapshot_copy,
)
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.learning_curriculum import plan_inventory
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.model_receipts import read_model_receipts
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.residual import _request_id
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.reviewed_patterns import run_workflow_input
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_admission import admit_records
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_history import digest
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_migration import migrate_revision
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_revisions import FORMAT as REVISION_FORMAT
from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.specification import compare_measurements, measure_dictionary
from GSE.lexicon_resource import ACTIVE_POINTER

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
NOTES = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = ROOT / "data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/checkpoint-foundation.db"
WORK = BASE.parent / "ssl-api-checkpoint"
QUESTIONS = NOTES / "ssl-api-controller-local-questions.json"
ANSWERS = NOTES / "ssl-api-controller-local-answers.json"
PLAN = NOTES / "ssl-api-controller-rebased-plan.json"
REBASE = NOTES / "ssl-api-controller-rebase.json"


class RetainedTransport:
    def __init__(self):
        rebase = read(NOTES / "ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json")
        self.identity = rebase["question_reuse"]["transport"]
        self.packet = read(QUESTIONS)
        self.requests = {row["request_id"]: row for row in self.packet["questions"]}
        directory = Path(rebase["question_reuse"]["journal_directory"])
        request = rebase["question_reuse"]["original_request_id"]
        intent = read(directory / ("teach-" + request + ".intent.json"))
        original = self.requests[request]
        if intent != {"request_id": request, "schema": original["schema"], "transport": self.identity}:
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_ORIGINAL_JOURNAL_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
        self.answers = {request: read(directory / ("teach-" + request + ".result.json"))["raw_output"]}
        if ANSWERS.exists():
            retained = read(ANSWERS)
            if (
                type(retained) is not dict
                or retained.keys() != {"format", "questions_sha256", "transport", "answers"}
                or retained["format"] != "GSE.ssl-checkpoint-local-answers/1"
                or retained["questions_sha256"] != fingerprint(QUESTIONS)
                or retained["transport"] != self.identity
                or type(retained["answers"]) is not list
            ):
                raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_ANSWERS_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
            seen = set()
            for row in retained["answers"]:
                if type(row) is not dict or row.keys() != {"request_id", "raw_output"}:
                    raise ValueError("INVALID_CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_ANSWER")
                identity = row["request_id"]
                if identity not in self.requests or identity in seen or type(row["raw_output"]) is not str:
                    raise ValueError("INVALID_CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_ANSWER")
                seen.add(identity)
                if identity in self.answers and self.answers[identity] != row["raw_output"]:
                    raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_ORIGINAL_REPLY_CHANGED")
                self.answers[identity] = row["raw_output"]
        self.replayed = []

    def __call__(self, payload, schema):
        identity = _request_id(payload)
        original = self.requests.get(identity)
        if original is None or original["request"] != payload or original["schema"] != schema:
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_QUESTION_CHANGED")
        if identity not in self.answers and ANSWERS.exists():
            refreshed = type(self)()
            if refreshed.identity != self.identity or refreshed.packet != self.packet:
                raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_RETAINED_ANSWERS_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
            self.answers = refreshed.answers
        if identity not in self.answers:
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_FRESH_INDEPENDENT_LOCAL_ANSWER_REQUIRED:" + identity)
        self.replayed.append(identity)
        return self.answers[identity]


def prepare():
    old = read(NOTES / "ssl-v2-reference-plan.json")
    catalogue = read(NOTES / "ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json")
    if fingerprint(BASE) != catalogue["rebased_sha256"] or fingerprint(ACTIVE_POINTER) != old["active_pointer_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_REBASE_INPUT_CHANGED")
    scopes = [{"id": "curriculum:physical-nondeictic", "guards": old["families"][0]["guards"]}]
    plan = {
        **old,
        "format": "GSE.lexicon-epoch-plan/2",
        "baseline_sha256": catalogue["rebased_sha256"],
        "epochs": 32,
        "curriculum": {
            "banks": ["I", "YOU"],
            "scopes": scopes,
            "frontier_limit": 64,
            "banks_per_entry": 2,
            "candidate_limit": 32,
            "audit_entry_ids": [identity for family in old["families"] for identity in family["holdouts"]],
        },
    }
    parse_plan(plan)
    record(PLAN, plan)
    record(
        REBASE,
        {
            "format": "GSE.ssl-checkpoint-rebase/1",
            "historical_plan": str(NOTES / "ssl-v2-reference-plan.json"),
            "historical_plan_sha256": fingerprint(NOTES / "ssl-v2-reference-plan.json"),
            "new_plan": str(PLAN),
            "new_plan_sha256": fingerprint(PLAN),
            "catalogue_rebase": str(NOTES / "ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json"),
            "catalogue_rebase_sha256": fingerprint(NOTES / "ssl-v2-catalogue-rebase.json"),
            "baseline": str(BASE),
            "baseline_sha256": fingerprint(BASE),
            "published_baseline": read(ACTIVE_POINTER),
            "published_baseline_pointer_sha256": fingerprint(ACTIVE_POINTER),
            "working_lineage": "UNPUBLISHED_FOUNDATION_WITH_REFERENCE_SOURCE_MIGRATION_AND_CATALOGUE_REPAIR_NOT_RELEASE_021",
            "new_local_question_budget": 128,
            "historical_water_I_question_cost": 1,
            "curriculum_change": "VERSIONED_OPEN_BANK_NATIVE_FRONTIER_WITH_RESERVED_DISJOINT_AUDITS",
            "semantic_gain_from_rebase": 0,
            "activation_performed": False,
        },
    )
    WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    inventory_path = WORK / "inventory.json"
    if not inventory_path.exists():
        record(inventory_path, plan_inventory(BASE, plan))
    return plan


def execute(*, retained_only=False, teaching_only=False):
    plan = read(PLAN)
    if fingerprint(BASE) != plan["baseline_sha256"] or fingerprint(ACTIVE_POINTER) != plan["active_pointer_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_PINNED_INPUT_CHANGED")
    model = RetainedTransport()
    result_path = WORK / "result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        result = read(result_path)
        if fingerprint(Path(result["candidate"])) != result["candidate_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_COMPLETED_CANDIDATE_CHANGED")
        return
    coordinates = model.packet["coordinates"][: 1 if retained_only else 2]
    required = {
        row["request_id"]
        for row in model.packet["questions"][
            : 1 if retained_only or teaching_only else len(model.packet["questions"])
        ]
    }
    if not required <= model.answers.keys():
        missing = sorted(required - model.answers.keys())
        record(
            WORK / ("pending-answers-" + digest(missing) + ".json"),
            {
                "code": "FRESH_LOCAL_ANSWERS_REQUIRED",
                "missing_request_ids": missing,
                "new_model_calls": 0,
                "bank_writes": 0,
            },
        )
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_FRESH_INDEPENDENT_LOCAL_ANSWERS_REQUIRED:" + ",".join(missing))
    fresh = make_questions(BASE, coordinates)
    for request in fresh:
        original = model.requests[request.request_id]
        if request.payload() != original["request"] or request.output_schema() != original["schema"]:
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_FRESH_QUESTION_MISMATCH")
    working = WORK / "teaching.db"
    snapshot_copy(BASE, working)
    baseline_path = WORK / "space-baseline.json"
    if not baseline_path.exists():
        record(baseline_path, measure_dictionary(BASE))
    teaching_path = WORK / ("typed-writer-retained.json" if retained_only else "typed-writer.json")
    if not teaching_path.exists():
        result = complete_dictionary(
            working,
            model,
            len(coordinates),
            entry_bank_questions=tuple(tuple(pair) for pair in coordinates),
            continue_cohorts=True,
            max_calls_per_entry=1,
            max_entries_per_pass=len(coordinates),
            priority="zipf",
            progress=lambda row: print(json.dumps(row), flush=True),
        )
        record(teaching_path, result)
    after_teaching_path = WORK / ("space-post-retained-teaching.json" if retained_only else "space-post-teaching.json")
    if not after_teaching_path.exists():
        record(after_teaching_path, measure_dictionary(working))
    if retained_only:
        record(
            WORK / "retained-teaching-result.json",
            {
                "code": "RETAINED_WATER_I_WRITTEN_AUDITS_AND_POSTFLIGHT_PENDING",
                "candidate": str(working),
                "candidate_sha256": fingerprint(working),
                "new_model_calls": 0,
                "historical_questions_reused": 1,
                "rule_admissions": 0,
                "activation_performed": False,
                "measurement": compare_measurements(read(baseline_path), read(after_teaching_path)),
            },
        )
        return
    if teaching_only:
        with closing(connect(working)) as conn:
            retained = read_model_receipts(conn)
            confirmed = [
                row["request_id"]
                for entry, bank in coordinates
                for row in retained.get(entry, ())
                if row["assertion"]["bank"] == bank and row["request_id"] in model.requests
            ]
        if len(confirmed) != len(coordinates):
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_TYPED_TEACHING_INCOMPLETE")
        record(
            WORK / "teaching-result.json",
            {
                "code": "EXACT_TYPED_TEACHING_COMMITTED_AUDITS_AND_REVISION_PENDING",
                "candidate": str(working),
                "candidate_sha256": fingerprint(working),
                "accepted_request_ids": confirmed,
                "new_model_service_calls_by_this_script": 0,
                "historical_water_I_question_cost": 1,
                "activation_performed": False,
                "measurement": compare_measurements(read(baseline_path), read(after_teaching_path)),
            },
        )
        return
    admissions = []
    with closing(connect(working)) as conn:
        indexed = read_model_receipts(conn)
        receipts = {entry: indexed.get(entry, ()) for entry, _ in coordinates}
    for index, family in enumerate(parse_plan(plan).values()):
        entry, bank = coordinates[index]
        receipt = next(row for row in receipts[entry] if row["assertion"]["bank"] == bank)
        taught = {
            "request_id": receipt["request_id"],
            "receipt_sha256": _request_id(receipt),
            "value": receipt["assertion"]["value"],
        }
        raw = reviewed_input(working, family, {"entry_id": entry}, taught)
        record(WORK / (family.id + "-input.json"), raw)
        audited = run_workflow_input(raw, model, max_calls=3)
        record(WORK / (family.id + "-audit.json"), audited)
        [candidate] = audited["candidates"]
        review = {
            "rule_id": candidate["relation"]["rule_id"],
            "warrant_sha256": candidate["warrant_sha256"],
            "review_id": "checkpoint-admission:" + family.id,
            "reviewer": family.warrant["reviewer"],
            "decision": "APPROVE_DEFINITIONAL_RULE",
            "source_refs": family.warrant["source_refs"],
            "rationale": family.warrant["statement"],
        }
        admissions.append(admit_records(raw, audited, review))
    inventory = read(WORK / "inventory.json")
    members = {
        row["entry_id"]: row for key, rows in inventory.items() if not key.startswith("curriculum:") for row in rows
    }
    rules, rows = scope_rows(working, members.values())
    staged = forecast(rows, rules, tuple(family.relation() for family in parse_plan(plan).values()))
    record(WORK / "joint-stage.json", staged)
    if staged["contradictions"] or staged["progress_code"] != "CONTRACTION":
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_SCOPE_CHALLENGE_OR_NO_EXACT_CONTRACTION")
    revision = {
        "format": REVISION_FORMAT,
        "baseline_version": admissions[0]["baseline_version"],
        "admissions": admissions,
        "retirements": [],
        "exceptions": [],
    }
    record(WORK / "joint-revision.json", revision)
    output = WORK / "candidate.db"
    migration_path = WORK / "migration.json"
    if not output.exists():
        record(migration_path, migrate_revision(working, output, revision))
    if migration_path.exists():
        migration = read(migration_path)
    else:
        # Atomic migration may have installed output just before interruption.
        # Reconstruct authority from its exact reviewed history, never adopt an
        # arbitrary preexisting output on the strength of a filename.
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.rule_history import read_history
        from GSE.curation.lexicon_builder.validation import _metadata, _relations, validate_build

        replay = validate_build(output)
        with closing(connect(output)) as conn:
            history = read_history(conn, _relations(_metadata(conn, "relations")))
        if not history or digest(history["events"][-1].get("revision")) != digest(revision):
            raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_RECOVERED_MIGRATION_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
        migration = {"postflight": replay, "recovered_from_exact_revision": digest(revision)}
        record(migration_path, migration)
    if migration["postflight"]["code"] != "REPLAY_VALIDATED" or not migration["postflight"]["complete_search"]:
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_POSTFLIGHT_FAILED")
    count, changed = exact_delta(working, output)

    def by_cell(items):
        return {(row["entry_id"], row["bank"]): row for row in items}

    if by_cell(changed) != by_cell(staged["changes"]):
        raise ValueError("CHECKPOINT_STAGE_COMMIT_DELTA_MISMATCH")
    after = measure_dictionary(output)
    record(WORK / "space-post-revision.json", after)
    record(
        WORK / "result.json",
        {
            "code": "JOINT_REFERENCE_REVISION_REPLAYED_WORKLOAD_GATE_PENDING",
            "candidate": str(output),
            "candidate_sha256": fingerprint(output),
            "definitions_replayed": count,
            "replay": migration["postflight"],
            "new_model_calls_by_this_script": 0,
            "external_local_questions_replayed": len(set(model.replayed) - {fresh[0].request_id}),
            "historical_water_I_question_cost": 1,
            "teaching": compare_measurements(read(baseline_path), read(after_teaching_path)),
            "rule_revision": compare_measurements(read(after_teaching_path), after),
            "total": compare_measurements(read(baseline_path), after),
            "activation_performed": False,
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=("prepare", "retained-teaching", "teach", "execute"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.phase == "prepare":
        prepare()
    else:
        execute(retained_only=args.phase == "retained-teaching", teaching_only=args.phase == "teach")

"""Exact unresolved audit reservations, distinct from signed counterexamples."""

from dataclasses import replace

from .foundation import EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX, _exact_wordnet_ancestry, lexical_context, native_frame_source
from .residual import _request_id
from .rule_history import digest, relation_records


def reservation_source(conn, entry_id):
    """Reuse the exact native identity witnesses for WordNet and Wiktionary."""
    from .validation import _read_json

    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT l.lemma,l.pos,l.gloss,o.payload FROM definition_states d "
        "JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id JOIN source_observations o ON o.entry_id=d.entry_id "
        "WHERE d.entry_id=? AND o.scope='lexical' AND o.source IN ('wordnet_hierarchy','wiktionary') "
        "ORDER BY o.record_id",
        (entry_id,),
    )
    witnesses = []
    for lemma, pos, gloss, payload in rows:
        definition = dict(entry_id=entry_id, lemma=lemma, pos=pos, definition=gloss)
        observation = _read_json(payload)
        if _exact_wordnet_ancestry(definition, observation) or native_frame_source(definition, observation):
            witnesses.append({"definition": definition, "observation": observation})
    if len(witnesses) != 1:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_SOURCE_NOT_UNIQUE")
    return witnesses[0]


def reserve_relation(conn, rule, review, baseline):
    """Withhold one exact definition after a genuine null audit, assigning no sign."""
    from .rule_revisions import touches_scope
    from .validation import _read_json

    identity, bank, audit = review["entry_id"], review["bank"], review["audit"]
    if (
        type(identity) is not str
        or not identity
        or type(bank) is not str
        or bank not in rule.banks
        or rule.authority != "conditional"
        or not rule.approved
    ):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_RESERVATION_TARGET")
    guard = (EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX + identity, "true")
    if guard in rule.guards:
        raise ValueError("DUPLICATE_REVISION_RESERVATION")
    source = reservation_source(conn, identity)
    if digest(source) != review["source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    scope = replace(rule, guards=tuple(g for g in rule.guards if not g[0].startswith(EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX)))
    context = lexical_context(source["definition"], (source["observation"],), (scope,))
    if not touches_scope((scope,), context):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_OUTSIDE_SCOPE")
    if (
        type(audit) is not dict
        or audit.get("code") != "MODEL_ABSTAINED"
        or type(audit.get("model_calls")) is not int
        or audit["model_calls"] != 1
        or audit.get("entry_id") != identity
        or audit.get("bank") != bank
        or audit.get("writes") is not False
        or type(audit.get("transport_identity")) is not str
        or not audit["transport_identity"]
        or type(audit.get("raw_output")) is not str
    ):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_REQUIRES_ABSTAINING_AUDIT")
    if _read_json(audit["raw_output"]) != {bank: None}:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_NOT_NULL")
    request = audit.get("request")
    if (
        type(request) is not dict
        or audit.get("request_id") != _request_id(request)
        or request.get("entry_id") != identity
        or request.get("bank") != bank
        or request.get("definition") != source["definition"]
        or request.get("fill") != {bank: None}
        or type(request.get("observations")) is not list
        or digest(source["observation"]) not in {digest(item) for item in request["observations"]}
    ):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
    values, known, scaffold = request.get("allowed_values"), request.get("known"), request.get("scaffold")
    if (
        type(values) is not list
        or len(values) not in (2, 3)
        or any(type(value) is not int or value not in (-1, 0, 1) for value in values)
        or len(set(values)) != len(values)
        or type(known) is not dict
        or bank in known
        or type(scaffold) is not dict
        or type(scaffold.get("domains")) is not dict
        or scaffold["domains"].get(bank) != values
    ):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_BASELINE_MISMATCH")
    records = scaffold.get("approved_relations")
    if type(records) is not list or any(type(record) is not dict for record in records):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_BASELINE_MISMATCH")
    tables = [
        {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key not in {"disposition", "reason", "requested_component"}}
        for record in records
    ]
    expected = relation_records(sorted((rule for rule in baseline if rule.approved), key=lambda rule: rule.rule_id))
    if digest(tables) != digest(expected):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_BASELINE_MISMATCH")
    expected_schema = {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {bank: {"type": ["integer", "null"], "enum": [*values, None]}},
        "required": [bank],
        "additionalProperties": False,
    }
    if audit.get("schema") != expected_schema:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")
    if any(
        type(value) is not int or value not in (-1, 0, 1) or scaffold["domains"].get(key) != [value]
        for key, value in known.items()
    ):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_RESERVATION_BASELINE_MISMATCH")
    return replace(rule, guards=tuple(sorted((*rule.guards, guard))))

"""Read-only candidate export for explicit reviewed-pattern preparation.

An inventory is not a review. Only supplied hash-pinned ACCEPTED reviews enter
the executable input; all other receipts remain visibly unreviewed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

from GSE.namespace import current_id

from .evidence import Observation
from .foundation import lexical_context
from .interchange import read_json
from .residual import _request_id
from .reviewed_patterns import INPUT_FORMAT, LEGACY_INPUT_FORMAT, _definition_input, _fields, _ids, reviewed_rulings
from .validation import (
    _assertions,
    _authorities,
    _domain_restrictions,
    _metadata,
    _NativeReference,
    _provenance,
    _read_json,
    _relations,
    _restriction_provenance,
)

SELECTION_FORMAT = "GSE.reviewed-pattern-selection/1"
EXPORT_FORMAT = "GSE.reviewed-pattern-export/1"


def _selected_observations(conn, entry_ids):
    """One source-table scan; retain full records for exact and candidate links."""
    selected = set(entry_ids)
    result = defaultdict(list)
    # SQL chooses records, not textual fragments; every matching native record
    # is decoded and checked whole. The connection is query-only.
    selection_json = json.dumps(sorted(selected))
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT record_id,entry_id,source,family,scope,payload FROM source_observations "
        "WHERE entry_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) "
        "OR (entry_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(payload,'$.candidate_entry_ids') c "
        "WHERE c.value IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))) ORDER BY record_id",
        (selection_json, selection_json),
    )
    seen = set()
    for record_id, entry_id, source, family, scope, payload in rows:
        raw = _read_json(payload)
        _fields(raw, ("record_id", "entry_id", "source", "family", "scope", "features", "candidate_entry_ids"))
        candidates = _ids(raw["candidate_entry_ids"])
        observation = Observation(
            raw["entry_id"], raw["source"], raw["record_id"], raw["family"], raw["features"], raw["scope"], candidates
        )
        if (observation.record_id, observation.entry_id, observation.source, observation.family, observation.scope) != (
            record_id,
            entry_id,
            source,
            family,
            scope,
        ):
            raise ValueError("OBSERVATION_COLUMN_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH")
        if record_id in seen:
            raise ValueError("AMBIGUOUS_OBSERVATION_ID")
        seen.add(record_id)
        targets = (entry_id,) if entry_id is not None else candidates
        for target in set(targets) & selected:
            result[target].append(raw)
    return result


def export_reviewed_input(candidate: str | Path, selection: dict, *, input_format=INPUT_FORMAT) -> dict:
    """Export a consistent read-only selected snapshot and explicit review input."""
    from .rule_history import digest, read_history, receipt_binding_key, relation_records

    if type(input_format) is not str or current_id(input_format) not in {INPUT_FORMAT, LEGACY_INPUT_FORMAT}:
        raise ValueError("INVALID_PATTERN_INPUT_FORMAT")
    _fields(
        selection, ("format", "discovery_entry_ids", "audit_entry_ids", "reviews"), ("candidates", "guarded_candidates")
    )
    if current_id(selection["format"]) != SELECTION_FORMAT or type(selection["reviews"]) is not list:
        raise ValueError("INVALID_PATTERN_SELECTION")
    discovery = _ids(selection["discovery_entry_ids"])
    audit = _ids(selection["audit_entry_ids"])
    if set(discovery) & set(audit):
        raise ValueError("DISCOVERY_AUDIT_ID_OVERLAP")
    selected = tuple(sorted(set(discovery) | set(audit)))
    if not selected:
        raise ValueError("EMPTY_PATTERN_EXPORT")
    reviews = {}
    for record in selection["reviews"]:
        _fields(record, ("request_id", "review"))
        if type(record["request_id"]) is not str or not record["request_id"]:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_PATTERN_REVIEW_ID")
        if record["request_id"] in reviews:
            raise ValueError("DUPLICATE_PATTERN_REVIEW")
        review = record["review"]
        if (
            type(review) is not dict
            or not _ids(review.get("source_refs", []))
            or type(review.get("rationale")) is not str
            or not review["rationale"].strip()
        ):
            raise ValueError("SOURCE_BACKED_REVIEW_REQUIRED")

    path = Path(candidate).resolve(strict=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        conn.execute("BEGIN")
        relations = _relations(_metadata(conn, "relations"))
        history = read_history(conn, relations)
        anchors, models = _authorities(conn)

        entries, inventory, accepted = [], [], []
        for entry_id in selected:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT l.lemma,l.pos,l.gloss FROM definition_states d JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id "
                "WHERE d.entry_id=?",
                (entry_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError("UNKNOWN_PATTERN_DEFINITION")
            assertions = _assertions(
                conn.execute("SELECT ordinal,payload FROM builder_assertions WHERE entry_id=?", (entry_id,)).fetchall()
            )
            restrictions = _domain_restrictions(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT ordinal,payload FROM builder_domain_restrictions WHERE entry_id=?", (entry_id,)
                ).fetchall()
            )
            anchor_counts = Counter(anchors.get(entry_id, ()))
            native_assertions, explicit_anchors = [], []
            for assertion in assertions:
                if anchor_counts[assertion]:
                    explicit_anchors.append(asdict(assertion))
                    anchor_counts[assertion] -= 1
                elif assertion.family != "model" and not assertion.source.startswith("model:"):
                    native_assertions.append(asdict(assertion))
            raw = {
                "definition": {"entry_id": entry_id, "lemma": row[0], "pos": row[1], "definition": row[2]},
                "assertions": native_assertions,
                "anchors": explicit_anchors,
                "observations": observations[entry_id],
                "domain_restrictions": [asdict(item) for item in restrictions],
            }
            raw["context"] = lexical_context(raw["definition"], raw["observations"], relations)
            # JSON normalization preserves the public schema's arrays.
            raw = _read_json(json.dumps(raw))
            parsed = _definition_input(raw, relations)
            native = {
                (item["source"], item["record_id"]): _NativeReference(item["entry_id"], item["family"], item["scope"])
                for item in observations[entry_id]
                if item["scope"] == "lexical"
            }
            relevant = {entry_id: [item["record_id"] for item in observations[entry_id]]}
            _restriction_provenance(entry_id, restrictions, native)
            _provenance(
                entry_id,
                assertions,
                parsed.definition,
                relations,
                native,
                relevant,
                anchors,
                models,
                conn,
                evidence_banks=parsed.evidence_banks,
                domain_restrictions=restrictions,
                rule_history=history,
            )
            entries.append(raw)
            for receipt in models.get(entry_id, ()):
                request_id = receipt["request_id"]
                dependencies = [
                    item["record_id"]
                    for item in receipt["request"]["scaffold"]["proof_trace"]
                    if item.get("kind") == "ASSERTION" and item.get("family") == "model"
                ]
                status = "EXPLICIT_REVIEW_SUPPLIED" if request_id in reviews else "NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED"
                inventory.append(
                    {
                        "entry_id": entry_id,
                        "bank": receipt["assertion"]["bank"],
                        "request_id": request_id,
                        "receipt_sha256": _request_id(receipt),
                        "review_status": status,
                        "dependency_status": "PRIOR_MODEL_DEPENDENCIES" if dependencies else "NATIVE_ANCHOR_BASELINE",
                        "dependency_request_ids": dependencies,
                        "receipt": receipt,
                    }
                )
                binding_key = receipt_binding_key(receipt) if history is not None else None
                if history is not None and binding_key is not None and binding_key in history["bindings"]:
                    identity, version = history["bindings"][binding_key]
                    inventory[-1]["rule_binding"] = {
                        "request_id": request_id,
                        "entry_id": identity,
                        "version": version,
                        "receipt_sha256": binding_key[1],
                    }
                if request_id in reviews:
                    accepted.append({"receipt": receipt, "review": reviews.pop(request_id)})
        if reviews:
            raise ValueError("REVIEW_NOT_IN_SELECTED_ACTIVE_RECEIPTS")
        reviewed_rulings(accepted)
        executable = {
            "format": input_format,
            "rulings": accepted,
            "discovery_entry_ids": list(discovery),
            "audit_entry_ids": list(audit),
            "entries": entries,
            "relations": relation_records(relations),
        }
        for key in ("candidates", "guarded_candidates"):
            if key in selection:
                executable[key] = selection[key]
        if history is not None:
            bindings = []
            for accepted_record in accepted:
                key = receipt_binding_key(accepted_record["receipt"])
                if key in history["bindings"]:
                    entry_id, version = history["bindings"][key]
                    bindings.append(
                        {
                            "request_id": key[0],
                            "entry_id": entry_id,
                            "version": version,
                            "receipt_sha256": key[1],
                        }
                    )
            if bindings:
                current_version = digest(relation_records(relations))
                needed = {current_version, *(record["version"] for record in bindings)}
                executable["rule_history"] = {
                    "format": "GSE.reviewed-pattern-history/2"
                    if history["allow_revisions"]
                    else "GSE.reviewed-pattern-history/1",
                    "current_version": current_version,
                    "versions": [
                        {"version": version, "relations": relation_records(history["versions"][version])}
                        for version in sorted(needed)
                    ],
                    "bindings": sorted(bindings, key=lambda record: record["request_id"]),
                }
        return {
            "format": EXPORT_FORMAT,
            "candidate": str(path),
            "lexicon_writes": False,
            "model_calls": 0,
            "selected_provenance": "REPLAY_VALIDATED",
            "input": executable,
            "input_sha256": _request_id(executable),
            "selection_sha256": _request_id(selection),
            "inventory": inventory,
            "review_outcomes": dict(Counter(item["review_status"] for item in inventory)),
            "authority": "EXPLICIT_REVIEWS_ONLY_EXPORT_DOES_NOT_REVIEW_OR_APPROVE",
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def export_from_selection(candidate: str | Path, selection_path: str | Path) -> dict:
    return export_reviewed_input(candidate, read_json(selection_path))

"""A reviewed change to one pinned rule set, with exact-definition exceptions."""

import json
from dataclasses import replace

from GSE.namespace import current_id

from .foundation import EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX, _exact_wordnet_ancestry, lexical_context, validate_lexical_guards
from .rule_history import digest, relation_records

FORMAT = "GSE.rule-revision/1"
RESERVATION_FORMAT = "GSE.rule-revision/2"
REVIEW_FIELDS = {"review_id", "reviewer", "rationale", "source_refs"}


def _review(record, fields, *, optional=()):
    required = REVIEW_FIELDS | fields
    if type(record) is not dict or not required <= record.keys() <= required | set(optional):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_REVIEW")
    if any(type(record[key]) is not str or not record[key].strip() for key in REVIEW_FIELDS - {"source_refs"}):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_REVIEW")
    refs = record["source_refs"]
    if type(refs) is not list or not refs or any(type(ref) is not str or not ref.strip() for ref in refs):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_SOURCE_REQUIRED")


def exception_source(conn, entry_id):
    """Read the exact native definition and evidence used by a local exception."""
    from .validation import _read_json

    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT l.lemma,l.pos,l.gloss,o.payload FROM definition_states d "
        "JOIN lexemes l ON l.id=d.lexeme_id JOIN source_observations o ON o.record_id=d.entry_id "
        "WHERE d.entry_id=? AND o.entry_id=d.entry_id AND o.scope='lexical' AND o.source='wordnet_hierarchy'",
        (entry_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_SOURCE_MISSING")
    definition = dict(entry_id=entry_id, lemma=row[0], pos=row[1], definition=row[2])
    observation = _read_json(row[3])
    if not _exact_wordnet_ancestry(definition, observation):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
    return {"definition": definition, "observation": observation}


def rule_changes(before, after):
    """Approved relations whose applicability or consequence may have changed."""
    old = {rule.rule_id: rule for rule in before}
    new = {rule.rule_id: rule for rule in after}
    return (
        tuple(rule for rule in before if rule.approved and new.get(rule.rule_id) != rule),
        tuple(rule for rule in after if rule.approved and old.get(rule.rule_id) != rule),
    )


def touches_scope(relations, context):
    return any(all(context.get(key) == value for key, value in rule.guards) for rule in relations)


def reviewed_model_withdrawals(reviews, receipts):
    """Match an explicit local reconsideration to a live or archived receipt."""
    requested = set()
    for review in reviews:
        if "withdraw_model_receipt_sha256" not in review:
            continue
        key = review["withdraw_model_receipt_sha256"]
        matches = [row for row in receipts if digest(row) == key]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_MODEL_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
        [receipt] = matches
        claim = receipt["assertion"]
        if (
            receipt["entry_id"] != review["entry_id"]
            or claim["bank"] not in review["counterexample"]
            or claim["value"] == review["counterexample"][claim["bank"]]
        ):
            raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_MODEL_RECEIPT_NOT_OPPOSING")
        requested.add(receipt["request_id"])
    return tuple(sorted(requested))


def _except(conn, rule, review):
    identity = review["entry_id"]
    if type(identity) is not str or not identity or rule.authority != "conditional" or not rule.approved:
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_EXCEPTION_TARGET")
    guard = (EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX + identity, "true")
    if guard in rule.guards:
        raise ValueError("DUPLICATE_REVISION_EXCEPTION")
    source = exception_source(conn, identity)
    if digest(source) != review["source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    scope = replace(rule, guards=tuple(item for item in rule.guards if not item[0].startswith(EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX)))
    context = lexical_context(source["definition"], (source["observation"],), (scope,))
    if not touches_scope((scope,), context):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_OUTSIDE_SCOPE")
    values = review["counterexample"]
    if (
        type(values) is not dict
        or not values
        or not values.keys() <= set(rule.banks)
        or any(type(value) is not int or value not in (-1, 0, 1) for value in values.values())
    ):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_COUNTEREXAMPLE")
    if any(all(row[rule.banks.index(bank)] == value for bank, value in values.items()) for row in rule.allowed_rows):
        raise ValueError("REVISION_EXCEPTION_DOES_NOT_OPPOSE_RULE")
    return replace(rule, guards=tuple(sorted((*rule.guards, guard))))


def validate_revision_shape(revision):
    required = {"format", "baseline_version", "admissions", "retirements", "exceptions"}
    if type(revision) is dict and current_id(revision.get("format")) == RESERVATION_FORMAT:
        required.add("reservations")
    if (
        type(revision) is not dict
        or set(revision) != required
        or type(revision["format"]) is not str
        or current_id(revision["format"]) not in {FORMAT, RESERVATION_FORMAT}
        or any(type(revision[key]) is not list for key in ("admissions", "retirements", "exceptions"))
        or "reservations" in revision
        and type(revision["reservations"]) is not list
    ):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_RULE_REVISION")
    if any(type(record) is not dict or "input" not in record for record in revision["admissions"]):
        raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_ADMISSION")


def revision_relations(conn, before, revision):
    """Validate the exact change and reconstruct its resulting rule set."""
    from .rule_admission import verify_admission
    from .validation import _relations

    validate_revision_shape(revision)
    baseline = digest(relation_records(before))
    if revision["baseline_version"] != baseline:
        raise ValueError("MIGRATION_BASELINE_VERSION_MISMATCH")
    rules = {rule.rule_id: rule for rule in before}
    for review in revision["retirements"]:
        _review(review, {"rule_id", "rule_sha256"})
        identity = review["rule_id"]
        old = rules.get(identity) if type(identity) is str else None
        if old is None or old.authority != "conditional" or not old.approved:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_RULE_RETIREMENT_TARGET")
        if digest(relation_records((old,))[0]) != review["rule_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("RULE_RETIREMENT_WITNESS_CHANGED")
        del rules[identity]
    admitted = {}
    for admission in revision["admissions"]:
        verify_admission(admission)
        if admission["baseline_version"] != baseline:
            raise ValueError("REVISION_ADMISSION_BASELINE_MISMATCH")
        [rule] = _relations(json.loads(json.dumps([admission["relation"]])))
        if rule.rule_id in rules or rule.rule_id in admitted:
            raise ValueError("MIGRATION_RULE_ALREADY_PRESENT")
        admitted[rule.rule_id] = rule
    rules.update(sorted(admitted.items()))
    for review in revision["exceptions"]:
        _review(
            review,
            {"rule_id", "entry_id", "source_sha256", "counterexample"},
            optional=("withdraw_model_receipt_sha256",),
        )
        identity = review["rule_id"]
        if type(identity) is not str or identity not in rules:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_EXCEPTION_TARGET")
        rules[identity] = _except(conn, rules[identity], review)
    for review in revision.get("reservations", ()):
        from .rule_reservations import reserve_relation

        _review(review, {"rule_id", "entry_id", "source_sha256", "bank", "audit"})
        identity = review["rule_id"]
        if type(identity) is not str or identity not in rules:
            raise ValueError("INVALID_REVISION_RESERVATION_TARGET")
        rules[identity] = reserve_relation(conn, rules[identity], review, before)
    for admission in revision["admissions"]:
        rule = rules[admission["relation"]["rule_id"]]
        if any(
            (EXCEPTION_GUARD_PREFIX + entry, "true") not in rule.guards
            for entry in admission["warrant"].get("required_exception_ids", ())
        ):
            raise ValueError("REQUIRED_REVISION_EXCEPTION_MISSING")
        required = set(admission["warrant"].get("required_reservation_ids", ()))
        supplied = {r["entry_id"] for r in revision.get("reservations", ()) if r["rule_id"] == rule.rule_id}
        if not required <= supplied:
            raise ValueError("REQUIRED_REVISION_RESERVATION_MISSING")
    after = tuple(rules.values())
    validate_lexical_guards(after)
    if after == before:
        raise ValueError("EMPTY_RULE_REVISION")
    return after
